data.name: Vinayak Raut
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Vinayak Raut has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 83*, with an average of 44.78 and a quick strike rate of 281.82. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 53 sixes and 10 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.5 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 9.40. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
